findings.finding: The branch contained only three parts of a six-part transport payload and no durable full ruleset implementation.
findings.remediation: Removed transport machinery and implemented the repository-native target ruleset.

findings.finding: Every authored chip effect was unconditionally classified as unimplemented and no runtime enforced declared chip semantics.
findings.remediation: Added a closed declarative effect registry and pure chip inventory, activation, cancellation, scoring, transfer-hit and restoration engine.

findings.finding: The Stage-11 adapter replaced the official 20-transfer deadline cap with squad size 15 and its model rejected 20.
findings.remediation: Made the configured cap authoritative and added Stage-11 regression coverage.

findings.finding: An approved PLAYER_POINTS interpretation was incorrectly marked out of scope for capabilities that inherit PLAYER_POINTS.
findings.remediation: Capability interpretation scope now follows the governed inheritance lineage.

findings.finding: Schema-1.1 activation accepted a locally constructible approval without capability, freshness, conflict, golden, differential, reconciliation, or trusted-record binding.
findings.remediation: Activation now recomputes FULL_SEASON and requires self-hashed evidence plus a separately hash-bound approval trust store.

findings.finding: The target schema and target-claims contract could not represent a verified full-season target or exact transfer/chip activation semantics.
findings.remediation: Extended schema 1.1 compatibly and required the additional fields for production-eligible target rules.

findings.finding: Fresh-source capture stored the FPL help SPA shell but not the rule-bearing chunks and failed to capture controlling announcements.
findings.remediation: The reconciler resolves current Rules/FAQ chunks and captures six explicit official season sources plus bootstrap and help.

findings.finding: Branch readiness tests used repository-wide YAML heuristics, failed against workflow YAML, and expected artifacts that did not exist.
findings.remediation: Replaced them with explicit compile, capability, state-transition, governance and evidence tests.

findings.finding: Rule-source metadata had locators and access dates but no immutable capture digest/path/retrieval timestamp.
findings.remediation: Production-eligible schema-1.1 source entries now require all three capture fields.

findings.finding: Thirteen temporary workflows, payload fragments, handoff generators, a probe file and a corrupt manifest remained in the branch.
findings.remediation: Removed all transport-only material and added an absence regression.

findings.finding: Selling-price configuration did not state authoritative manager selling values or explicit floor-to-tenth rounding.
findings.remediation: Added both governed fields while preserving all integer branch behavior.

findings.finding: Chip configuration could not distinguish inventory per window, activation route, lock threshold, GW exclusions, or minimum gap.
findings.remediation: Added strictly validated data fields and executable regressions for every target chip.

findings.finding: The source reconciler retained unused sitemap heuristic discovery after explicit source routing was required.
findings.remediation: Removed the unused heuristic discovery path.

review_standard: Independent Sol correctness, governance, evidence and production-readiness review
